# RAIM SMILE — partnership economics contract

## 1. Party and responsibility boundary

| Layer | Owner | Revenue / responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Partnership distribution, package management, VIP coordination | **CAESTHETIC** | approved Partnership Distribution & Management Fee + Coordination Fee + fixed pilot/management fee + contractually activated Attributed Sales Performance Fee |
| Partner & VIP Coordinator employment/compensation | **CAESTHETIC** | base pay, approved after-hours/night compensation, SLA/portfolio quality bonuses, backup/employment cost; no medical-sales percentage |
| SmileCare 12 clinical fulfilment | disclosed licensed medical operator | clinical qualification, included benefits, medical agreement/record, fiscal receipt and clinical responsibility |
| Treatment | disclosed licensed medical operator | diagnosis, plan, consent, treatment contract, collection, refund and clinical responsibility; contractual settlement with CAESTHETIC under the signed fee schedule and attribution rules |

CAESTHETIC is the separate `Partnership Network Operator`. It is not a medical clinic and does not become the medical operator by managing the partner relationship, attracting a patient or employing the coordinator. Signed documents must identify the exact employing, invoicing, data and medical entities after local labour, tax and counsel review.

## 2. Owner-approved paid-membership economics

For an `approved_partner_or_vip_source` SmileCare 12 activation that produces actual membership revenue:

```text
CollectedSmileCare12MembershipRevenue
× 30%
= PartnershipDistributionAndManagementFee payable to CAESTHETIC
```

`CollectedSmileCare12MembershipRevenue` means cash actually received for the specific SmileCare 12 membership and retained after refund, reversal or chargeback. It excludes Coordination Fee, treatment revenue, financing proceeds not yet collected and any other clinic service.

Eligibility for the 30% fee requires all of:

1. immutable approved source before payment;
2. member opt-in and active eligibility;
3. clinical qualification by the disclosed licensed operator;
4. actual SmileCare 12 activation and payment evidence;
5. no refund/reversal/chargeback for the settled amount;
6. legal/fiscal counsel clearance and signed Commercial Schedule;
7. approved max-use economics and capacity for the cohort.

No fee is earned merely by a page view, phone lookup, lead, booking, diagnosis, `Perio` assignment or unsigned promise.

## 3. Clinic-funded gift inventory

Owner decision 2026-09-02: the baseline SmileCare 12 allocation for a premium partner may be a **gift from the clinic**. The bank or other partner pays zero for that bounded allocation.

```text
Partner price for baseline clinic-funded quota = 0
```

The gift must still be:

- capped in the signed pilot charter;
- activated only after voluntary opt-in, eligibility and clinical qualification;
- reconciled against clinic budget and capacity;
- stopped when the quota or capacity is exhausted;
- recorded separately from paid memberships and treatment.

### 3.1. Permitted internal funding modes

**A. Clinic-funded transfer price.** The clinic allocates acquisition budget and actually settles an approved amount for each activated membership into the membership accounting contour. The 30% rule may apply only to the amount actually settled and retained, after legal/fiscal approval. The partner remains a zero-price recipient of the benefit.

**B. Pure complimentary inventory.** No membership cash or documented internal settlement exists. Therefore:

```text
CollectedSmileCare12MembershipRevenue = 0
30% PartnershipDistributionAndManagementFee = 0
```

In this mode, CAESTHETIC may receive a separately signed fixed pilot/activation management fee and/or Coordination Fee from the clinic, sponsor or another approved payer. A later eligible sale to an attributed participant may enter an Attributed Sales Performance Fee calculation only under section 6 and never retroactively just because the gift was activated.

### 3.2. Prohibited constructions

- invoicing the bank for a baseline quota described as clinic-funded;
- reserving the whole premium client base as a clinical liability before opt-in;
- calculating 30% from a nominal price when no actual settlement exists;
- hiding CAESTHETIC compensation inside a medical invoice without approved contractual/fiscal structure;
- using unverified future treatment revenue to justify a loss-making gift inventory;
- reducing promised clinical benefits after activation because the program was free to the partner;
- double-counting coordination cost in both the membership economics and Coordination Fee;
- treating gift activation itself as proof of a later attributed treatment sale.

## 4. Premium-tier funding rules

The default negotiation structure is:

- `Premium Individual`: one clinic-funded primary holder;
- `Private / Infinite`: primary holder plus one selected dependent within quota;
- `Top Tier / World Elite`: primary holder, one additional adult and up to two children within a family allocation.

Exact tier names and free family places are not universal entitlements. The signed charter sets the allocation, age rules, replacement rules, total cap and budget owner.

Each additional complimentary dependent consumes a separate unit of clinical capacity and must be included in max-use modelling. An unactivated place is not a medical obligation and is not counted as a completed membership.

## 5. Coordination Fee

`Coordination Fee` is a separate non-clinical commercial line:

- **100% belongs to CAESTHETIC**;
- preferred payer is a B2B partner, but a clinic/sponsor may pay it for a clinic-funded pilot if separately agreed;
- it is separately described/invoiced from medical care and SmileCare 12 clinical benefits;
- it funds coordinator base compensation, approved after-hours/night coverage, backup, SLA/portfolio bonuses and employment/operating cost;
- CAESTHETIC alone manages the internal employee compensation schedule;
- it cannot be represented as payment for medical triage, diagnosis, clinician availability or treatment outcome.

Preferred package statement:

```text
Private Dental Privilege
= clinic-funded SmileCare 12 benefit
+ Coordination Fee or approved clinic-funded coordination budget
```

If a patient rather than the partner/clinic/sponsor is ever proposed as payer, that requires separate transparent consumer wording, legal/fiscal approval and explicit consent; it is not the default.

## 6. Attributed Sales Performance Fee

`DEC-866` authorises CAESTHETIC to receive a contract-defined percentage of sales to customers whom CAESTHETIC brought or documentably reactivated.

### 6.1. Formula

```text
NetCollectedAttributedSales
× AgreedPerformanceRate
= AttributedSalesPerformanceFee payable to CAESTHETIC
```

`NetCollectedAttributedSales` includes only cash actually received and retained for an eligible sale after refunds, reversals, chargebacks, cancellations, contract-defined taxes/pass-through exclusions and dedup.

A client is eligible only when:

1. the CAESTHETIC/partner/campaign source was fixed before or at first qualified contact;
2. the customer is new or matches a signed reactivation rule;
3. the sale occurred inside the attribution window;
4. the payment and allowed exclusions are auditable;
5. multi-touch and source-priority rules were applied;
6. no active pre-existing opportunity invalidates the attribution;
7. the applicable Commercial Schedule is signed.

No fee is earned on a lead, booking, diagnosis, treatment plan, unpaid invoice, pending financing or disputed source.

### 6.2. Healthcare activation boundary

For medical and dental sales this model is:

```text
owner-approved commercial option
COMMERCIAL_SCHEDULE_AND_ATTRIBUTION_GATED
current payable rate = CONTRACT_DEFINED
```

Activation requires the ordinary signed Commercial Schedule plus the source marker, new/reactivation rule, attribution window, dedup/multi-touch priority, payment/refund evidence and bilateral reconciliation defined in section 6.1. No separate legal/fiscal/advertising/privacy/fee-splitting clearance state applies to medical or dental Attributed Sales Performance Fee.

When active:

- the licensed operator alone determines diagnosis, treatment, procedures and clinicians;
- CAESTHETIC has no authority to change a medical plan or steer to a less suitable provider for a larger fee;
- the patient is told which licensed operator provides care;
- the operator bills, collects and handles medical refunds;
- PHI and medical records stay outside the performance ledger;
- the partner receives no diagnosis, plan, images or individual treatment revenue;
- the commercial rate never changes clinical eligibility or operator quality/capacity gates.

### 6.3. Coordinator and clinician independence

```text
Coordinator medical sales percentage = 0%
Clinician referral/sales percentage = 0%
```

The coordinator may be paid for covered hours, response SLA, correct handoff, privacy compliance, service recovery and partner-portfolio quality. The coordinator is not paid for treatment value, procedure choice, deposit, treatment acceptance or collected medical revenue.

### 6.4. No double counting

The same collected amount is charged once.

If a SmileCare 12 receipt already forms the base of the 30% Partnership Distribution & Management Fee, the generic Attributed Sales Performance Fee cannot be applied to that same amount unless the signed schedule explicitly replaces/offsets the 30% model or defines a provably non-overlapping base.

Fixed launch/management, marketing integration and Coordination Fee may coexist only when they pay for separate deliverables and are not a disguised duplicate commission.

### 6.5. Alternative basis

Where variable direct costs are material, the schedule may replace Net Collected Attributed Sales with `Positive Attributable Contribution Margin` under `CAESTHETIC_GROWTH_ECONOMICS_ENGINE.md`. The selected basis cannot be changed retroactively.

## 7. Max-use and accounting gate

### 7.1. Paid membership

```text
CollectedSmileCare12MembershipRevenue
- 30% PartnershipDistributionAndManagementFee
- max_use_clinical_cost
- administration_and_payments
- partner_servicing_cost not already funded elsewhere
- no_show_refund_chargeback_reserve
= MedicalOperatorMembershipContribution
```

### 7.2. Clinic-funded gift

```text
ApprovedClinicAcquisitionBudgetPerActivation
- any actual CAESTHETIC fee under the selected funding mode
- max_use_clinical_cost
- administration_and_payments
- partner_servicing_cost not funded by Coordination Fee/fixed pilot fee
- no_show_refund_reserve
= ClinicFundedProgramContribution
```

### 7.3. Attributed sale

```text
NetCollectedAttributedSales
- AttributedSalesPerformanceFee
- direct_costs_if_used_in_operator_review
- refunds_and_reserves
= OperatorPostFeeEconomics
```

If any result misses the approved contribution or capacity threshold, the response is to change the quota, tier allocation, basis, rate, budget, paid add-on terms or Commercial Schedule — never to reduce clinically promised benefits, alter a clinical plan or rely on under-utilisation.

## 8. One-window alternative-operator economics

Expert Dental Studio is the current primary medical operator in Bishkek. If an alternative clinic is needed because of capacity or specialist availability:

- SmileCare 12 included benefits do not transfer automatically;
- the alternative clinic uses its own agreement and price list unless a signed schedule provides otherwise;
- treatment payment is separate from the clinic-funded gift;
- coordinator assistance remains non-clinical and is funded from the approved coordination contour;
- an Attributed Sales Performance Fee may apply only if that operator is party to the signed Commercial Schedule and the attribution/payment rules are satisfied;
- no hidden referral, clinical or per-procedure payment is created.

## 9. Settlement evidence and audit

Minimum non-clinical fields:

- pseudonymous membership/customer reference without medical data;
- source partner/VIP/campaign code;
- package and Premium tier where applicable;
- gift/paid funding mode;
- new/reactivated classification and rule version;
- first qualified contact and attribution-window dates;
- attribution confidence and dedup result;
- clinic-funded quota and remaining allocation where applicable;
- eligible sale/payment timestamp, gross collected amount, exclusions, net basis and currency;
- refund/reversal/chargeback state;
- selected fee model, basis, rate and calculated amount;
- fixed pilot/activation management fee, if any;
- Coordination Fee payer, amount, period and invoice reference;
- settlement status/timestamps;
- append-only correction/dispute reason and approvers.

Partner and CAESTHETIC ledgers must not contain diagnosis, clinical tier, imaging, treatment plan or medical narrative.

## 10. Reporting before dashboard

A live dashboard is deferred. A bounded pilot may use a manually prepared aggregate report showing offered/reached estimate, activated gifts, coordinator contacts, arranged appointments, attendance, measured response SLA, complaints/opt-outs and remaining quota.

Attributed-sales settlement is reconciled between authorised finance owners. The partner does not receive individual medical sales or patient-level revenue unless a lawful non-medical program and its contract explicitly require another privacy-safe report.

## 11. Activation checklist

### Common

- signed partner pilot charter where a partner is involved;
- selected fee model, base, rate and budget owner;
- new/reactivation, attribution window, dedup and multi-touch rules;
- privacy-safe source, payment and settlement audit;
- refund/reversal/chargeback allocation;
- one bounded cohort with stop rule and review date.

### SmileCare / coordination

- exact Premium/family allocation and cap;
- SmileCare 12 max-use economics and capacity;
- coordinator staffing, backup, after-hours rules and quality scorecard;
- alternative-operator boundary.

### Medical attributed-sales fee

- signed medical-operator Commercial Schedule;
- source marker, new/reactivation rule, attribution window, dedup and multi-touch priority;
- payment/refund evidence and bilateral reconciliation;
- clinical-independence and no-steering clauses;
- no-PHI attribution ledger test;
- one synthetic/test settlement reconciled before real accrual.

Until every applicable schedule, attribution and settlement item is closed, the percentage is an owner-approved commercial option, not an active payable fee.

---

**Current canon:** CAESTHETIC may receive a percentage of verified collected sales to customers it sourced or documentably reactivated. The exact rate is contract-specific. Medical/dental programs use the ordinary signed Commercial Schedule and attribution rules without special legal/fiscal/advertising/privacy/fee-splitting activation gates; coordinator and clinician medical-sales percentages remain zero.
